name: Glyph
description: Nissa's magic for tapping a plane's leyline network so its energy can be channeled through Chandra.

timeline.summary: Nissa visits the glyph at night and plants four seeds, including a Jaddi tree and a bloodbriar, at its center.
timeline.quote: One by one she planted them in the holes she had dug.

timeline.summary: Nissa lights with magic and weaves Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashes around the titans.
timeline.quote: A tripartite glyph a hundred feet wide appeared on the floor of the valley in fierce green fire.

pages_say.description: A circle with three equidistant projections, the shape the leylines must take to bind the Eldrazi.
The glyph of leylines burned permanently into the valley floor, glowing green, where Nissa plants her seeds.
A tripartite glyph of leylines a hundred feet wide, burned into the valley floor, that binds the titans.
Nissa's magic for tapping a plane's leyline network so its energy can be channeled through Chandra.
